text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this manga finally hit over 100 
million copies in print! I mean, the anime 
and live-action movie were both big hits, 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It's thrilling so many people...! 
It's selling all over the world, so people 
across the globe are enjoying this manga—!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna lose either! I'll blow the 
whole world away with my work! Over a 
hundred million people! Beyond all 
borders!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to create it! A run that 
transcends language and everything else— 
and gets hearts pumping at maximum 
throttle...!
